title: UserQuota
description: Runtime view of a user's plan consumption. Plan tiers and limits are signed in INGEST_SECURITY.md v1.0 §4. BYOK fields reflect the signed BYOK model for Free and Creator (project_foco_byok_model.md). Contract anchors: UX_FROZEN.md v1.3 §5.4 + INGEST_SECURITY.md v1.0 §4-§4.3.

plan.description: Signed plan set. 2026-04-17: Free $0 BYOK / Creator $39 BYOK / Influencer $99 managed / Celebrity $199 managed / Studio custom.

storageLimitBytes.description: Hard cap. Free 500 MB, Creator 10 GB, Influencer 50 GB, Celebrity 200 GB, Studio custom.

uploadsDailyLimit.description: Soft daily ceiling. Warn at 80%, block at 100%, reset 00:00 UTC.

videosCycleLimit.description: Hard cap within the billing cycle. Free 5, Creator 60, Influencer 300, Celebrity 1000, Studio custom.

seatsLimit.description: 1 for Free/Creator/Influencer, up to 3 for Celebrity, custom for Studio.

maxUploadFileBytes.description: Per-file ceiling. Free 100 MB, Creator 500 MB, Influencer 500 MB, Celebrity 2 GB, Studio custom.

cycleResetsAt.description: Next billing-cycle reset (usually the plan anniversary).

llmKeyProvider.description: Set when the user has registered a BYOK key. null = not set (blocking for Free/Creator; fallback-optional for Influencer+).

llmKeyStatus.description: Cached status of the BYOK key. Updated after each LLM call or on user edit. UI reads this to show correct state without touching the key.

infectionEscalationStep.description: INGEST_SECURITY §4.3 rolling 30d counter. 0 = clean, 1 = 30min ban, 2 = 12h, 3 = 24h, 4 = 72h, 5 = indefinite pending human review.

infectionsLast30d.description: Count of confirmed infections in the rolling 30d window. Drives escalation-step increments.
